⚡️🇰🇵🇰🇷🇺🇸 — Kim Yo Jong Confirms Intermediate-Range Missile Test Featuring Advanced Trajectory and AI Guidance, — Reuters. 
​➡️ North Korean official Kim Yo Jong formally confirmed that Pyongyang successfully conducted an intermediate-range strategic missile test, overseen directly by leader Kim Jong Un. The confirmation follows initial tracking reports from the South Korean military indicating that a ballistic missile flew over 700 kilometers toward the sea off the country's east coast. Kim asserted that the test utilized a specialized "wave-like trajectory mode" designed to exploit and expose vulnerabilities in regional tracking architecture, claiming that monitoring assets operated by Seoul and Tokyo failed to properly track the projectile past its initial skip points. 
​➡️ Highlighting technological advancements in Pyongyang's arsenal, Kim stated that the test integrated artificial intelligence to dynamically alter the missile's flight orbit at low altitudes. She maintained that these capabilities render traditional defense tracking systems ineffective, underscoring an ongoing push to refine maneuverable payload delivery systems. This strategic demonstration follows heightened cross-border friction, including a public dismissal by Pyongyang of Seoul's demands for an apology regarding landmine incidents in the Demilitarized Zone, alongside a steady cadence of missile tests protesting joint U.S.-South Korean military exercises.

🦅 ☠️ CIA's secret weather control files resurface 
Declassified CIA documents from 1965 reveal America's plans to manipulate the weather as a weapon of war, the Daily Mail reports — and conspiracy theorists are calling it proof the agency has been "poisoning the sky" for decades.
🔴 The 18-page report discussed weather modification — launching rockets or using planes to dump chemicals into the atmosphere to alter climate and storm systems
🔴 It noted federal funding for the secret program was set to be four times higher in 1967 — the same year the US began spraying toxins over Vietnam
🔴 President Lyndon B. Johnson's letter praised the classified operation, specifically mentioning work manipulating a hurricane near Florida — believed to be Hurricane Betsy, which hit Louisiana as a Category 4
🔴 Two programs followed: Project Stormfury, which flew into hurricanes and seeded them with silver iodide to weaken storms, and Project Popeye, used against enemy supply lines during the Vietnam War to artificially extend the monsoon season
🔴 Records later showed the US seeded clouds with toxic lead iodide near the Ho Chi Minh Trail, causing landslides — lead is toxic to humans with no safe level of exposure
In 1962, then-Vice President Johnson said: "He who controls the weather will control the world." Three years later, he was overseeing two weather-modification programs — and the files are now public.

🇮🇷 Any new aggression against Iran will trigger a more lethal response - IRGC
Any new attack on Iran would trigger a “painful and regret-inducing” response, Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps warned while marking the second anniversary of Operation True Promise II, according to Press TV.
The IRGC said the October 2024 operation demonstrated Iran’s ability to strike Israel with large-scale missile attacks and was carried out in retaliation for the killings of senior Iranian and allied figures, including Ismail Haniyeh, Hassan Nasrallah, and IRGC commander Abbas Nilforoushan.
💬 “The era of cost-free threats has ended,” the IRGC said, arguing that any future aggression by the US, Israel, or their regional partners would face a response stronger than True Promise II.
In October 2024, Iran launched nearly 200 ballistic missiles at Israel, a strike the IRGC now cites as a warning that any future attack on Iran would carry a higher cost.
